title: Matthew Bible Quiz - Chapter 13
description: Ten questions on Matthew 13: the farmer and the seeds, the darnel weeds, the mustard seed, the pearl of great price and his own country.

questions.text: What happened to the seeds that fell by the roadside?
questions.explanation: As the farmer sowed, some seeds fell by the roadside, and the birds came and devoured them.

questions.text: Why did the seeds on rocky ground wither away?
questions.explanation: They sprang up at once but were scorched when the sun rose, and they withered away because they had no root.

questions.text: How much fruit did the seed on good soil yield?
questions.explanation: Others fell on good soil and yielded fruit: some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty.

answers.text: Seven, five and three times as much
Ten, twenty and thirty times as much
Thirty, forty and fifty times as much
A hundred, sixty and thirty times as much

questions.text: What did Jesus say had been given to the disciples?
questions.explanation: He said that to them it is given to know the mysteries of the Kingdom of Heaven, but not to the others.

answers.text: The parable of the mustard seed
To know the mysteries of the Kingdom
A reward in the day of judgment

questions.text: In the explanation, who snatches away what was sown by the roadside?
questions.explanation: When someone hears the word and doesn't understand it, the evil one comes and snatches away what was sown in his heart.

questions.text: What did the enemy sow among the wheat while people slept?
questions.explanation: While people slept, his enemy came and sowed darnel weeds among the wheat, and went away.

questions.text: What did the householder say should be done at harvest time?
questions.explanation: He said to let both grow until the harvest, when the reapers would gather the darnel weeds in bundles to burn and gather the wheat into his barn.

answers.text: Gather the weeds to burn and the wheat into the barn
Pull up the weeds at once before harvest
Burn the whole field and sow it again
Leave both in the field through the winter

questions.text: To what is the Kingdom of Heaven compared, which is smaller than all seeds?
questions.explanation: The Kingdom of Heaven is like a grain of mustard seed, which is smaller than all seeds, but grows greater than the herbs.

questions.text: What did the merchant do when he found one pearl of great price?
questions.explanation: Having found one pearl of great price, he went and sold all that he had, and bought it.

answers.text: He sold all he had and bought it
He hid it again in the field
He gave it away to the poor
He sowed it in his own field

questions.text: What did the people in his own country ask about him?
questions.explanation: They were astonished at his wisdom and works and asked whether this was not the carpenter's son, whose mother is called Mary.

answers.text: Isn't this the son of David?
Isn't this Elijah who was to come?
